title: Cyrus and the Thorn
author: Xanthe Villalobos
blurb: Sebastian Reyes, an exiled storm-caller, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
